alert_restore: Bring the newer state back to {device}
alert_text: On {device}, the state from {when} was replaced by an older one, probably by another program. The newer one is backed up.
alerts_text: The newer ones are backed up and can be brought back on the game's page.
conflict_text: The save changed on more than one PC since the last sync. Choose the state to continue with; the other stays as a version.
conflicts_text: Both states are saved. Choose on the game which one continues.
conflicts_title: {n} game(s) were played on two PCs
custom_empty: No custom games yet. A PC proposes one with spielstand-agent custom add, for example from Claude Code (spielstand-agent skill install).
custom_kind_extend: Adds to a game of the manifest
custom_proposed: Proposed by {device}, in effect only there
custom_text: Games Spielstand does not find on its own, or more places for a known game. One path per line, with the Ludusavi manifest's placeholders, e.g. <xdgData>/Game/saves or <winAppData>/Game. What is here applies on every PC.
default_mode_text: Applies to every game you set nothing else for.
device_remove_confirm: Remove {device}? Its history stays; the device has to be paired again.
devices_empty: No device paired yet. “Add device” gives you the command for the first PC.
devices_subtitle: Every PC with an agent, connected to this server
event_branched: Played on two PCs, kept as a branch
event_overwritten: Newer state replaced by an older one
event_resolved: State chosen in the web interface
foreign_stellwerk: Stellwerk still syncs this save too. The exclusion is being added; until Stellwerk has taken it over, Spielstand only backs up here.
foreign_syncthing: Syncthing syncs this save too (folder {folder}). As long as it is not excluded there, Spielstand only backs up here. Set the game to “Back up only” if Syncthing should keep moving it.
game_folders_saved: Saved. The device looks there now.
game_folders_text: Folders that hold games with their own Wine prefix, one path per line. ~ is the device's home folder.
games_empty: No games yet. They show up as soon as an agent runs.
games_subtitle: Every game with saves on one of your PCs
import_done: Took over {games} game(s) with {versions} version(s), skipped {skipped}.
import_source: Ludusavi backup folder or rclone remote
import_text: Takes over every old Ludusavi backup with its date, comment and lock. The original is only read. Imported versions are never loaded on their own.
launch_text: Optional: loads the newest state right before the start and backs up after it ends. Without it the agent syncs in the background.
loc_proposed: A custom game this PC proposed: it is only backed up here until it is taken over for every PC.
locations_text: Where the save lives and whether every device is current
login_text: Sign in to see your saves.
mirror_how: No mirror set up. Set SPIELSTAND_MIRROR, e.g. to an rclone remote like gdrive:Spielstand.
mirror_text: Every version is also copied offsite. A lost server can be rebuilt from it.
mode_backup_text: Spielstand backs up every change but never writes itself. Another program such as Stellwerk (or nobody) moves the saves.
mode_sync_text: Spielstand loads the newest state on every PC, before the start and in the background.
overview_none: No version yet. Pair a PC to get started.
pair_step1: Puts the agent into ~/.local/bin and sets up the systemd user service
pair_step2: Pairs the PC with this server and asks for its name
pair_step3: Shows the optional Steam launch option
pair_text: Run in a terminal on the new PC. No root needed; works on Bazzite and the Steam Deck. The code is valid for 15 minutes.
pair_update: Already paired? To update the agent, run the command without a code; the PC stays the same device:
problem_no_prefix: No Wine prefix found for this game. Enter the prefix folder (the one with drive_c):
problem_several: Several prefixes could belong to this game. Which one is it?
problem_several_emulators: Several emulators have a save of this game. Which one is right?
problem_start_in_emulator: Start the game once in {emulator}. Only then does {emulator} take a save from another device.
recent_text: Where you played last and whether every device is current
restore_continues: Every PC continues from this state afterwards; their current states stay as versions.
restore_no_device: No device connected. Loading needs a device whose agent runs.
restore_safety: The state on the target PC is saved as its own version first. You can always go back.
restore_sent: Sent to {device}. If the game runs there right now, nothing is loaded.
setup_text: Set the password for the web interface (at least 8 characters).
versions_text: From every device · nothing is overwritten
